text:
nisha: Quick PM follow-up for the DB outage. I need concise confirmations: Owner | one-line AC | ETA | Jira. I'll paste the replies into the actions table and close after verification.

omar: I'll own the KV TTL patch + unit tests. AC: TTL corrected + tests covering high-fanout case. ETA: 2026-04-08. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-12021

kevin: I'll take perf regression investigation and add a small 99p benchmark to CI. AC: 99p latency within 2% of baseline or documented rollback path. ETA: 2026-04-09. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-12022

alexa: I'll own the canary/rollout config and the rollback thresholds, and update the postmortem Owners table. AC: 24h canary with automated rollback signal documented. ETA: 2026-04-10. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-12023

sam: I'll produce the oncall runbook steps and a one-click rollback script. AC: runbook step + tested rollback command on staging. ETA: 2026-04-07. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-12024

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-12024 (sam) due in 3 days.

nisha: Minimal acceptance criteria I'll paste in each ticket: 1) fix merged + unit tests, 2) perf within 2% or rollback available, 3) canary config + 24h verification, 4) postmortem doc updated with RACI + ticket links. Add a short verification note when you close the ticket.

omar: Adding AC to RDW-12021 and opening a PR with a small perf snapshot. PR checklist going into the ticket.

kevin: Created RDW-12022 and wired a micro-benchmark to CI; will attach results to the ticket.

alexa: Linked all tickets in the postmortem and updated the Owners table with RACI: R=owner, A=nisha, C=peers, I=oncall rotation. Set ISO due dates.

sam: RDW-12024 pushed; rollback tested on staging. Adding the runbook link into the postmortem doc.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-12021 (omar) and RDW-12023 (alexa) marked high priority by nisha.

nisha: Great work. I'll verify ACs in planning and then close the action items. If any ETA slips, escalate in #postmortems. Closing thread after QA sign-off. :wave:
